svg.title: What the agents pay
svg.desc: For each configuration beside 24 agent sessions, each run and the median of the agents' TTFT p99, of the share of the engine's steps over the calls in which the prefill hold kept agent prefill out, and of make-room's own preemptions over the calls: Tuned vLLM 0.32 (the baseline, 10 runs): TTFT p99 106 s (96 to 129), no hold, no make-room; A router (aborts and resubmits, 5 runs): TTFT p99 193 s (160 to 232), no hold, no make-room; make-room (#63350, 5 runs): TTFT p99 112 s (98 to 131), agent prefill held in 0% of the steps, 34 preemptions by make-room; make-room + prefill hold (16-token window, 5 runs): TTFT p99 105 s (99 to 130), agent prefill held in 25% of the steps, 32 preemptions by make-room; make-room + prefill hold (48-token window, 15 runs): TTFT p99 111 s (94 to 132), agent prefill held in 33% of the steps, 31 preemptions by make-room.
